description: A stereo reverb and delay processor built for an effects loop, which passes no dry signal of its own

params.text: Sets how much reverb reaches the outputs, from silence to eight tenths of the reverb signal at fully clockwise
Sets how much of the delayed signal reaches the outputs
Sets the length of the delay line from 0 to 500ms; the setting is smoothed, so turning the knob sweeps the pitch of whatever is already in the line
At DEL 1 only the plain delay tap is heard; at DEL 2 extra taps come in at two thirds of the delay time on the left and one third on the right; at DEL 3 those move to three quarters and one quarter
Switched up to REV BIG the reverb runs its longer set of delay lines, for a larger space; down at REV SML it runs a shorter set

inputs.text: Scaled to three quarters and summed with the other input into the mono signal that feeds both the reverb and the delay line

outputs.text: The left output: the reverb scaled by REVERB MIX plus the delay taps scaled by DELAY MIX, with no dry signal in it
The right output: the reverb scaled by REVERB MIX plus the delay taps scaled by DELAY MIX, with no dry signal in it

notes: no dry signal passes through this module. Patch it into an effects loop, or mix the dry signal back in yourself, or you will hear only reverb and echo.
the CLIP lamp lights when either output passes 5V peak.
